reason: Calendar date partitions overlap in event time, and repeated (user_id, video_id, time_ms, tab) event keys occur within logs.
canonical_clock: Unix time_ms interpreted as UTC; supplied date remains an audited metadata field, not the split clock or a predictor.
evaluation: standard and random policies separately, with 2022-04-22T00:00:00Z <= time_ms < 2022-05-09T00:00:00Z
duplicate_rule: Quarantine every row belonging to an event-key group of size greater than one across the three logs. This rule uses keys only, not label agreement or model outcomes.
claim_limit: Conservative exploratory clean-cohort probe. Report exclusion counts and coverage. This is not an assertion that every repeated key is an erroneous event or that date metadata are corrupt.
